capabilities.description: The rink manager can create and schedule skating sessions, hold them, put held sessions back on sale or cancel them, and the public can list sessions in schedule order.
capabilities.name: Skating session scheduling and management

capabilities.description: Customers can buy tickets for skating sessions. Prices are worked out, available capacity is reduced when club bookings block part of the rink, and overselling is prevented. Bookings are stored and looked up by session.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales and session availability

capabilities.description: The rink keeps a fixed stock of hire skates for each shoe size and reserves them alongside ticket bookings, so customers can't hire more skates than are available.
capabilities.name: Skate hire inventory

capabilities.description: Customers pay for bookings through the external PuckPay payment provider. Payment results arrive by webhook and settle the bookings, and tickets for cancelled sessions are refunded.
capabilities.name: Online payment and refunds

capabilities.description: Members can get free sessions they are entitled to, and bookings that stay unpaid past the 15-minute payment window are released so the tickets and skates go back on sale.
capabilities.name: Membership free-session entitlement and unpaid booking expiry
